purpose: Verbatim third-party legal evidence and source provenance for unchanged official AMD SDK payload repacking. Not publication authorization or a legal certification.

collection_scope.original_notice_observation: Nine LICENSE-named files in core; no LICENSE/NOTICE-named files in libraries or any of the three device wheels. Original notices retained unchanged and supplemental pinned-source texts collected.
collection_scope.mapping_limit: Source inventory and component associations are evidence, not blanket grants. Some conservatively collected notices concern code/build tools not present in a given wheel. Only exact upstream texts control.
collection_scope.file_content_policy: Upstream license/notice wording and copyright/external spellings are preserved. Header excerpts are labeled and traceable to archive members/source paths. Source/build recipes are retained unmodified, including upstream comments.
collection_scope.no_checks: No build, test, lint, formatter or qualification checks were run by this collection task. Acquisition hashes are provenance/integrity evidence only.
collection_scope.device_gfx1250_source_provenance: The device wheel requires rocm-sdk-libraries==10.1.0 but has no independent source manifest. Existing supplemental notices and pinned core SDK source associations are reused by component path, including rocjitsu translations; this is not an independently attested device build revision or redistribution approval.

integration.mapping: Each component lists exact original payload paths/patterns and associated evidence files. All component wheels carry the shared legal collection to avoid losing dependencies across core/libraries/device boundaries.
integration.source_archives: Large source artifacts are staged only under .tmp/rocm-source, not checked into Git and not silently claimed to be delivered by the wheel.

TheRock enables cholmod and does not explicitly disable GPL modules. The three hipDNN provider roots have SPDX MIT CMake headers but no standalone license found; complete their attribution and dependency notice mapping before release.
